_comment: Hand-read from the card faces in data/images-tts/. Keyed by name + saga. Used by check-ocr.ts to measure extraction accuracy against known-correct values rather than against a previous run. Add rows as more cards are verified by eye.

cards.name: Saiyan Truce Card
cards.text: End combat. Until the Discard Step of your next turn, you may keep any cards in your hand during any Discard Steps. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

cards.name: Android 17 Smirks
cards.text: Villains only. Choose 1 opponent and remove all of his Drills in play from the game. Limit 1 per deck. Remove from the game after use.

cards.name: Android 17's Back Bash
cards.text: Physical attack doing 5 power stages of damage. If this attack is performed by Android 17. your opponent must skip his next attack phase.

cards.name: Ally Wins!
cards.text: Your opponent discards one life card for every ally you have in play. Remove from the game after use.

cards.name: A Burst of Energy
cards.text: Use when needed. Raise all of your personalities to their highest power stage. Remove from the game after use.
cards._note: The atlas cell clips the last letters of 'power' at the panel edge; the printed word is power.
